TaskDescription: Cognitive-boundary paradigm (Zheng et al. 2022, 2024). Encoding: participants watched 90 novel silent movie clips (about 8 s each) that contained no boundary (NB, continuous shot), soft boundaries (SB, cuts to another scene of the same movie) or a hard boundary (HB, cut to a different movie), answering occasional yes/no questions. Scene recognition: old/new judgement with confidence on frames from the clips (targets) and foils. Time discrimination: choose which of two frames from a clip appeared first, with confidence. All three parts are in one continuous recording; events.tsv gives every trial.
Instructions: Encoding: watch the clips and answer the occasional yes/no content question. Scene recognition: indicate whether the frame was seen (old) or not (new) and your confidence. Time discrimination: indicate which frame (left or right) appeared earlier and your confidence (Zheng et al. 2022, 2024).
ElectrodeManufacturersModelName: Behnke-Fried hybrid macro-micro depth electrodes (micro inner wire bundle, 8 microwires of 40 µm diameter)

Broadband.Description: Broadband neural signals recorded at 32 kHz with 0.1-8000 Hz filtering (Zheng et al. 2024, Methods).

DownsamplingByAuthors.Description: The source series is described in the NWB as 'LFP recordings that have been downsampled to 200 Hz' (rate attribute 200 Hz) from the 32 kHz broadband signal. The anti-aliasing filter used for the released series is not documented. Zheng et al. (2024, Methods) describe, for their analysis, replacing the LFP in a 3 ms window centred on each detected spike by linear interpolation and downsampling from 32 kHz to 250 Hz; whether spike interpolation was applied to the released 200 Hz series is not stated. None of this was applied by the BIDS conversion.

iEEGReference: Not documented in the source release for these microwire recordings.
iEEGGround: Not documented in the source release.
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically placed hybrid depth electrodes for seizure monitoring in patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, sampling amygdala, hippocampus, parahippocampal gyrus and, in some participants, dorsal anterior cingulate cortex, pre-supplementary motor area and ventromedial prefrontal cortex. Only the microwires present in the source LFP series are included (the release includes LFP for a subset of the microwires).
iEEGElectrodeGroups: Each source electrode is its own NWB ElectrodeGroup (NLX-microwires-<channel>); the channels.tsv group column gives the recording site (one Behnke-Fried bundle).
LFPSeriesDescription: These are LFP recordings that have been downsampled to 200 Hz
